title: SCFT/VOA correspondence and R-twisted reductions of $(A_2,D_{3n-2})$ Argyres--Douglas theories
summary: We study the SCFT/VOA correspondence for the $(A_2,D_{3n-2})$ Argyres--Douglas theories with $n\geq2$. From the matching of the central charges and the equality of the Schur index with the vacuum supercharacter to all orders, we propose that the associated VOA is the logarithmic doublet algebra $\mathcal A(4n-2)$ of Feigin, Feigin, and Tipunin. For $n=2$, this correspondence was studied in detail by Buican and Nishinaka, and our proposal extends it to $n\geq3$.
